resources.name: Alloy input parameters (Z, r_C, Ω₀, θ_D) from Table 1

access.notes: CSV file with columns: glass, C (concentration of element B), Z (alloy valence), r_C (core radius in au), Omega0 (atomic volume in au^3), theta_D (Debye temperature in K). Values extracted from Table 1 of the paper.

resources.notes: Input parameters needed for the computational workflow. The ionic mass M for each glass is computed from C and standard atomic masses of the constituent elements.
